note: jackal (Jackal — RL / Defender / Iron / Burst I, cd 20s, ammo 6, reloadFrames 142, chargeFrames 60, chargeMult 250, normalMult 65.02, Missilis). Pinned line-by-line by scripts/tests/units/jackal.test.ts (J1-J5). TIER 2. JACKAL IS A TANK: most of her kit is out-of-domain for a damage sim, and her two DEF grants are damage-inert (self/team DEF never feeds damage dealt in v1 — the boss never attacks). Her one damage-relevant contribution is the burst amp below. || SKILL1 'Happy Jackal' ('Activates when attacked 10 time(s). Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest final Max HP. Damage Taken ▲ 9.09% for 10 sec. ATK ▼ 9.09% for 10 sec.'): the Damage-Taken half IS encoded on the kit's real `attacked:10` trigger, and is honestly DORMANT at scope lock — the sim has no incoming-damage model and the v1 boss never acts, so nothing feeds the counter and the block applies nothing. It goes live the day incoming attacks are modeled. Granting it uptime today would fabricate what the sim cannot produce (maiden's 'attacked 20 times' Revenge cluster is the binding precedent); the nearest-wrong encodings — a permanent always-up damageTakenPct and an 'attacks-misread' hitCount:10 on her own shots — are both pinned RED in the unit test. The ATK ▼ half is UNMODELED (verbatim in unmodeled.skill1): the engine has no enemy-ATK model at all, because the v1 boss deals no damage — this is independent of the enemy DEF ▼ channel that landed 2026-08-10. || SKILL2 'Jumpin' Jackal Flash' ('Activates at the start of battle. Affects self and 2 ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK.'): line 1 'Equally shares damage taken for 120 sec' is UNMODELED (verbatim) — no damage-redistribution primitive and no incoming damage to redistribute (bay/marciana/poli precedent). Line 2 'DEF ▲ 8.27% for 120 sec' is TWO passive (frame-0) defPct 8.27/120s blocks: self + alliesTopAtk{count:2, excludeSelf:true, byFinalAtk:true}. byFinalAtk per the A3 literal-word rule (the kit says 'highest FINAL ATK' — milk/maxwell/miranda precedent); excludeSelf because 'self AND 2 allies' = three distinct units. The 120s duration LAPSES at t=120 in the 180s fight (asserted, not permanent), and defPct is damage-inert in v1 (byte-identical totals with the blocks removed — pinned). || BURST 'Crazy Jackal' (B1, cd 20s, 'Affects all allies.'): line 1 'Burst Skill damage of skills with "Affects 1 enemy unit(s)" in the description ▲ 38.91% for 15 sec' is MODELED as burstSkillSingleDamagePct 38.91 to all allies for 15s on her burstCast (the stat + the burstDesc scope-tag channel landed 2026-08-10; trina carries the 'Affects all enemies' sibling). It is read ONLY by burst-slot damage instances tagged burstDesc:'singleEnemy', which is the engine's expression of the kit's description-text scope: qualification is decided at override-authoring time per damage line, not by string-matching at runtime. As a B1 her cast precedes the chain's B3 by under a second, so the 15s window covers the rotation's single-target burst nuke. The nearest-wrong encoding — unscoped all-allies attackDamagePct 38.91, wrong bucket AND wrong scope — is pinned RED. Line 2 'DEF ▲ 14.69% for 10 sec' is burstCast -> allies -> defPct 14.69/10s (her OWN cast, landing before the FB window opens; inert in v1, byte-identical-totals pinned). || Cadence: no ⚑ (the cadence-tuple flag was retired by owner ruling 2026-07-25 — datamine tuple reliable); no charFixes. Burst gauge: no row in data/gauge-per-shot.json, so the class-modal fallback applies; her kit carries no gauge line (flatPerTrigger 0 is faithful). No `ignored` blocks. Every modeled magnitude is verbatim lvl-10 kit text (DATAMINED). || ⚑ LIST: [⚑1] (OUT-OF-DOMAIN, incoming-damage subsystem — TIER 2) the S1 attacked-10x cluster. estimate = if fireable, near-permanent uptime after the first 10 hits taken (her tank role feeds the counter in real fights), i.e. a ~+9.09% team-wide amp for most of the fight; the ATK ▼ half is zero-impact by construction. recipe = needs an incoming-damage model plus a measured boss attack cadence/targeting before any encoding — an unanchored interval proxy would be fabrication (there is no datamined cooldown for S1: skillCooldownsSec.skill1 = null). tier = out-of-domain (maiden/yulha/noise/admi precedent). [⚑2] (UNMEASURED PLACEMENT — TIER 2) the amp's additive Damage-Up placement follows the '○○ Damage ▲' family rule (damage-formula SSOT §2) and has not been directly measured for this stat. recipe = popup-read a qualifying single-target burst nuke cast inside vs outside her 15s window and check the ratio against additive-vs-multiplicative composition.

caveats: burst: the 38.91% Burst-Skill-Damage amp ('Affects 1 enemy unit(s)' scope) is MODELED — burstSkillSingleDamagePct 38.91 to all allies for 15s on her burstCast, read only by burst-slot hits tagged burstDesc:'singleEnemy'. Scope qualification is LITERAL: the kit says 'skills with "Affects 1 enemy unit(s)" in the description', so a damage block qualifies only when its own clause contains that exact string (owner ruling 2026-08-10, which covers trina's sibling amp identically). NO unit on the roster qualifies today — crow, elegg, novel and viper were each tagged on a paraphrase and untagged again when the ruling landed, so this amp currently reaches nothing anywhere. The engine does not string-match kit prose; the tag is an authoring-time decision, so a qualifying nuke left untagged silently misses the amp and the tag is the thing to check when a jackal comp reads cold. Decidable by `npx tsx scripts/census-burst-amp-scope.ts`. ⚑2 covers the unmeasured additive placement.

skill1: the attacked-10x Damage Taken ▲9.09%/10s is MODELED as an honestly-DORMANT block (attacked:10 → enemy damageTakenPct 9.09): the trigger exists but nothing feeds it at scope lock (no incoming-damage model; the boss never attacks), so it applies nothing today and goes live the day incoming attacks are modeled. Her in-game tanking role feeds the counter, so real uptime is high and comps read COLD by that amp until then (⚑1). The ATK ▼9.09% half stays unmodeled — the engine has no enemy-ATK model, the boss dealing no damage.
skill2: 'Equally shares damage taken' (self + 2 highest-final-ATK allies, 120s) is unmodeled — no redistribution primitive and no incoming damage at scope; defensive.
Both DEF grants are damage-INERT in v1. Beyond the burst amp, jackal's modeled kit contributes zero damage — her own output is her bare RL weapon, and the S1 boss debuff remains out-of-domain (⚑1).
